note: Single-config offline approximation. Not a search. Not a sealed EURUSD holdout. promote=no.
fill_contract: closed-bar signal on i; fill at close[i] (next-open approximation). SL/TP first checked on a later bar. Pivots stamp at confirmation bar c+right via htf_fib_core.

clock.h4_resample: pandas resample('4h') left-labels the bucket; residual <=4h optimism vs a true H4 close. MTF eligibility is not the parity htf_available_at rule.
clock.not: America/New_York. Not Vantage server hour unless the CSV was exported that way.

book.points_note: PnL uses price delta * contract * lots. No spread column is charged. Frictionless — not live-matched. EURUSD pip = 0.0001 = 10 MT5 points; this runner does not convert to pips.

window.split: free research slice, not a sealed develop/holdout. Do not rank or select on this window. XAU HTF selection uses results/xau_holdout_lock.json via backtest.py / family protocol.
